en.headline: West Kowloon Picnic Fest opens on Art Park lawn from 18 September
en.dek: The new autumn series runs on selected weekends and public holidays until 11 October, with food stalls, workshops, live music and a bike-and-picnic pass.
body: West Kowloon Cultural District will launch its first Picnic Fest on the Art Park harbourside east lawn from 18 September to 11 October, operating on Fridays to Sundays and public holidays between 2pm and 9pm.

Organisers said the event combines food stalls, themed workshops organised with The Picnic Club Hong Kong, live performances and a new Bike & Picnic Pass that includes cycling access and dining offers. Picnic sets will be available from designated outlets in the park, with foldable chairs redeemable on site.
The series is intended as an autumn outdoor programme by Victoria Harbour. Specific opening hours on 1 October are shortened to 2pm–6pm to accommodate National Day arrangements.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節9月18日起於藝術公園海濱草坪舉行
zh.dek: 活動逢周末及公眾假期至10月11日，設美食市集、工作坊、現場表演及單車野餐套票。
body: 西九文化區將於9月18日至10月11日在藝術公園海濱東草坪推出「西九野餐節」，逢周五至周日及公眾假期下午2時至晚上9時開放。
主辦單位表示，活動結合特色餐飲市集、與野餐俱樂部合作的主題工作坊、現場音樂表演，以及全新「單車野餐套票」，涵蓋單車、野餐及餐飲優惠。園區指定商戶提供野餐套餐，可即場換取摺疊椅。
10月1日開放時間因應國慶活動調整為下午2時至6時。活動旨在讓市民在維港景致下享受秋日戶外體驗。
